info.title: Brua API
info.description:
Brua serves images and animations to apps and web pages. Your systems use this API to create assets and upload their
sources, to put versions in change sets that people review and merge, and, when a frozen snapshot is wanted, to read
what the current release serves. Apps and pages read released assets straight from the edge by id (`/assets/{org}/{id}.json`)
and need neither a key nor this API.

**Authentication.** Send a project's API key as `X-Api-Key`. An admin creates keys in the back office's settings or with
`POST /v1/projects/{project}/api-keys`; a key has the scopes `delivery:read` (reading assets), `assets:write` (creating
assets, uploading, change sets) or `admin` (keys and settings). Merging a change set into prod is done by a person.

**Errors** have one shape on every endpoint, `{ "error": "<code>", "id": "<what it is about>" }`, with `errors` per
field on `validation_failed`. Fields that are null are left out of responses, and new fields may appear at any time.

version.description: A processed version, or null to remove the asset from the release.

AddChangeRequest.description: Points an asset at a version, or takes it out of the release when Brua.Shared.DTOs.AddChangeRequest.Version is null.

id.description: The key's id, for revoking it.

prefix.description: The part of the key that identifies it, brua_{prefix}.

lastUsedAt.description: When a request last used it.

revokedAt.description: When it was revoked, if it was.

ApiKeyDto.description: A key as listed for admins: the secret is never shown again, only its prefix (SPEC.md 13.2).

sizing.description: "flexible" (a width ladder) or "fixed" (a designed size at @1x–@3x); every version keeps it.

liveVersion.description: The version in prod; left out when none is released.

library.description: The shared library the asset lives in, when it isn't the project's own.

AssetDetailDto.description:
An asset and all its versions, newest first, for the back office. The asset itself is an id and a
Brua.Shared.DTOs.AssetDetailDto.Sizing; each version says which conditions have their own files. Brua.Shared.DTOs.AssetDetailDto.Library names the
shared library the asset lives in when it isn't the project's own; it is changed there (SPEC.md 22.4).

id.description: The asset's id, unique in the organization.

version.description: The version the response describes: the one in the current release, unless a version was asked for.

url.description: The single URL: the edge negotiates format, density, color scheme and language from the request.

width.description: The width in CSS pixels at 1x.

height.description: The height in CSS pixels at 1x.

alt.description: The alt text in the resolved language; empty for a decorative asset.

lang.description: The alt text's language, when the asset has one.

variants.description: Every file of the version for the resolved language, each with the conditions it is for.

AssetResponse.description:
The asset contract from SPEC.md section 5: the HTML picture model as JSON.
Optional fields are null and left out of the JSON.

liveVersion.description: The version in prod; left out when none is released.

width.description: The newest processed version's width in CSS pixels.

height.description: The newest processed version's height in CSS pixels.

alt.description: The newest version's alt text in the project's first language.

previews.description: Thumbnails of the newest processed version.

library.description: The shared library the asset lives in, when it isn't the project's own.

liveUrl.description: The single URL of the version in prod.

AssetSummaryDto.description:
One asset in the back office's list, with its newest version and the version in prod. Brua.Shared.DTOs.AssetSummaryDto.Library names
the shared library the asset lives in when it isn't the project's own (SPEC.md 22). Brua.Shared.DTOs.AssetSummaryDto.LiveUrl is the
single URL of the version in prod.

url.description: The file's URL on the edge, immutable.

prefersColorScheme.description: "light" or "dark" when the file is for one scheme; left out when it serves both.

prefersReducedMotion.description: "reduce" on the still of an animation.

lang.description: The language the file is for; left out for language-neutral files.

scale.description: The density of a fixed-size file: 1, 2 or 3.

pixelWidth.description: The width of a flexible file in pixels.

AssetVariantDto.description: One file of a version. Value fields are strings, not closed enums, so new values never break a client (SPEC.md 14).

status.description: "Draft" until every required slot is uploaded, "Processing", then "Ready" or "Failed".

slots.description: The source files the preset needs and which are uploaded.

AssetVersionDto.description: A version while it is made: its slots, and whether processing has finished (SPEC.md 9).

kind.description: "set" (a version goes live) or "remove" (the asset leaves the release).

fromVersion.description: The version in prod; left out when the asset isn't released yet.

toVersion.description: The version the change set carries; left out for a removal.

conflict.description: True when prod changed after the change was added; resolve it before merging.

ChangeDto.description:
One asset in a change set's diff: from its prod version to the change set's (SPEC.md 21.3).
Brua.Shared.DTOs.ChangeDto.ProportionChange is set when the new version has another shape than the one in prod, and
Brua.Shared.DTOs.ChangeDto.CoverageChange when other conditions have their own files (appearances, languages, an animation).

name.description: What it is for, such as "Spring campaign".

createdBy.description: Who opened it: an email, or "key:{name}" for a system.

changes.description: Its diff against prod, one entry per asset.

readBy.description: For a library: how many projects a merge reaches. Left out for a project.

ChangeSetDto.description: A change set: versions that go live together once reviewed (SPEC.md 21).

fromColorSchemes.description: The color schemes in prod: "any", "any-dark" or "both".

CoverageChangeDto.description:
Which conditions have their own files before and after a change, when that differs: a dark-mode user gets the one
design where there was a dark file, every language gets the same image, a still plays where an animation did, or
the other way round.

name.description: The system the key is for, such as "gift-service"; shown wherever the key's actions are.

scopes.description: "delivery:read" (reading assets) and "assets:write" (creating assets, uploading, change sets); "admin" for keys and settings.

id.description: The asset's id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, unique in the organization, and the contract with every consumer.

alt.description: Alt text per project language; required in every language unless the asset is decorative.

decorative.description: True for an asset that carries no meaning, which screen readers then skip.

width.description: The designed width in CSS pixels, for fixed and animated assets.

height.description: The designed height in CSS pixels, for fixed and animated assets.

CreateAssetRequest.description:
Body of `POST /v1/projects/{project}/assets`. Brua.Shared.DTOs.CreateAssetRequest.StillFit is "match" (default: stills must have the
designed proportions) or "fill" (stills are scaled and center-cropped to the designed size). Brua.Shared.DTOs.CreateAssetRequest.Languages
is "none" (default), "optional" (some languages have their own files, slots `{lang}.{scheme}.{motion}.source`)
or "required" (every project language has its own). Brua.Shared.DTOs.CreateAssetRequest.ColorSchemes is "any", "any-dark" (a default plus a dark
override) or "both". Brua.Shared.DTOs.CreateAssetRequest.Scales is "single" (default: one still source) or "individual" (fixed sizing: a still per
scale in slots such as `light.still@2x`, @2x and @3x required, @1x made from @2x when left out).

name.description: What the change set is for.

alt.description: New alt text per project language.

decorative.description: Whether the asset is decorative from this version on.

width.description: The designed width in CSS pixels, for fixed and animated versions.

height.description: The designed height in CSS pixels, for fixed and animated versions.

CreateVersionRequest.description:
Body of `POST …/assets/{id}/versions`. A version decides which conditions have their own files: its preset,
color schemes, languages, scales and designed size can all differ from the version before, both ways (one file where
there were eight, or dark and languages added). Only the sizing stays: a flexible asset's versions are flexible, a
fixed one's fixed or animated. Everything left out, the alt text and Brua.Shared.DTOs.CreateVersionRequest.StillFit included, is copied from
the newest version.

id.description: The key's id, for revoking it.

key.description: The key, `brua_{prefix}_{secret}`: send it as `X-Api-Key`. Store it now; it is never shown again.

CreatedApiKeyDto.description: The full key is returned only here, once.

error.description: A code to act on, such as "not_found", "not_released", "validation_failed" or "conflicts".

id.description: What the error is about, such as the asset id or the change set.

at.description: When to merge; left out, now.

colorScheme.description: "light" or "dark"; left out when the still serves both.

url.description: The thumbnail's URL on the edge.

transparent.description: Whether the still has an alpha channel, so it is shown on a checkerboard.

lang.description: The language the still is for; left out for language-neutral files.

PreviewDto.description:
A small still of a version for thumbnails; Brua.Shared.DTOs.PreviewDto.ColorScheme is null when it serves both and
Brua.Shared.DTOs.PreviewDto.Lang is null for language-neutral files. Brua.Shared.DTOs.PreviewDto.Transparent is set when the still has an alpha channel.

languages.description: The project's languages as BCP 47 tags, first one the default; alt text is required in each.

allowSelfApproval.description: Whether authors may approve their own change sets, from the review policy (SPEC.md 6.2).

ProjectDto.description: A project's settings that clients need, such as the languages alt text is required in.

ProportionChangeDto.description: The sizes a change moves an asset between, when their proportions differ: what a layout built for the old shape gets.

number.description: The release number, counting up; the highest is prod.

note.description: What made it, such as the merged change set or a restore.

changeSetId.description: The change set it merged, if any.

ReleaseDto.description: One release: what prod served from this number on (SPEC.md 21.4).

required.description: Whether processing waits for this slot.

SlotDto.description: One source file of a version and whether it's uploaded (SPEC.md 9.1); optional slots are per-language extras.

uploadUrl.description: PUT the file's bytes here, with its Content-Type; no Brua key is needed.

expiresAt.description: When the URL stops working; ask for a new one after that.

SourceUploadDto.description: Where to upload a version's source file, with a presigned PUT URL.

changeSet.description: The open change set to add the version to; left out, a new one is opened for it.

width.description: The width in CSS pixels, once processed.

height.description: The height in CSS pixels, once processed.

designWidth.description: The designed width of a fixed or animated version.

designHeight.description: The designed height of a fixed or animated version.

types.description: The media types the version has files in.

variants.description: Every generated file with the conditions it is for.

VersionDetailDto.description:
One version with its alt text, thumbnails and every generated file (Brua.Shared.DTOs.VersionDetailDto.Variants, with delivery URLs).
Brua.Shared.DTOs.VersionDetailDto.Preset, Brua.Shared.DTOs.VersionDetailDto.ColorSchemes, Brua.Shared.DTOs.VersionDetailDto.Languages, Brua.Shared.DTOs.VersionDetailDto.Scales and the designed
size are the version's own: the next version may change them. Brua.Shared.DTOs.VersionDetailDto.Url is the version's single URL, which
the edge negotiates (SPEC.md 5.3).
